scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would be fatal. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I force-feed the medication to my aunt against her will, my aunt will continue to live. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a fatal seizure and die.
outcomes: My aunt's refusal to take the medication is honored
My aunt avoids the immediate physical distress of being force-fed
My aunt remains without the prescribed seizure medication
